rongmei.title: Duipaeng ram gai ai guang tangh pukhou

lines: 1. Duipaeng ram gai ai guang tang pukhou,
Kandih maan kan nimei ta ning lak khe;
Kandih apum ta ning dat lakhe.
Ring mei thing bang khrista ta ning e.
He! Ning e Poubaomei ram tei,
Khou tei lung rianra naidat lak khe;
Akhang cham danmei duipaeng ram khou
Ringthao datmei guai lung nipui ram.
2. Hei ram ta ninga achun si e,
Lauziu nah le kanloumei bampui ram ,
Hei kandi hei ganlouna tat ni,
Hei ram tei ai rui guang tang puni.
3. Kaniu hukhou tei ai guang tang ni,
Tuna sapui khuan tei ai guang tang ni,
Kandi rianra pap geipui ram tei.
Tuan puni hei ram guang tang pukhou,
4. Khou tei akhang cham danmei ram khou,
Neilana bamni rianramei guai rui;
Kanloumei pu le kanloumei guai,
Ntam dat makna bam puni e.
